stem: What SIMILAR idea about sending messages is found in the article “More Than Air”?

options.label: A
options.text: Some groups of people have special ways of sending messages through sound.

options.label: B
options.text: People can learn to send messages by listening to animal sounds.

options.label: C
options.text: The first instruments for sending messages were carved in the shape of animals.

options.label: D
options.text: Instruments were a popular way to send messages in the past.

visual_elements: "I really don't know," Grandma says. "It's a secret language. Spend enough time with them, and maybe you’ll figure it out."
